text:
maya (procurement): FYI AlphaLogistics just pushed an update on AWB 7777-2400. Mixed H200/A800 wave, partial arriving tomorrow 04:00 UTC (36 units). Remaining ~48 units ETA in 3 business days. Customs flagged HS mismatch; forwarder says possible 36-48h hold unless we reroute via FRA. Need quick decision: accept partial + wait, or reroute (expedite fee) to keep staging window. @alpha-logistics can you summarise options/pricing?

alpha-logistics (supply-broker): Short options: 1) Accept partial (36) and await rest in ~3 days. No additional fee but you miss EU pool window if <40. 2) FRA reroute: clears same-day, expedite fee +$415 but avoids 48h hold. 3) Accept partial + air-topup of 4 units to hit window: topup cost ~$1,100 and takes 6-12h to source. Also note: manifest flagged 2 units as soft-DOA. We can provide return labels (PDF 4x6) and vendor offers $225/unit credit as alternative to returns for soft-fail. Commercial invoice update here: https://al-logistics.example/doc/7777

dan (fleet): Staging needs >=40. Partial 36 -> we either get topup or reroute. Topup cost high. Reroute fee seems cheaper than missing pool. Ops impact if we delay is ~€2.5k in lost capacity this week.

sophia (ops): Depot policy reminder: DOA units must have pre-created RMA and PDF return labels attached before arrival. If not, depot quarantines entire AWB. @rma-bot can you open a provisional RMA and list depot acceptance checklist?

rma-bot: provisional RMA created: #RMA-43124 for AWB 7777-2400. Depot checklist: 1) attach full serial manifest (CSV or inline) to RMA; 2) attach return labels as PDF (4x6); 3) include photos for any DOA units; 4) signed credit terms for any vendor credits. Missing PDF labels -> depot_quarantine = true. RMA status = pending_docs.

tom (finance): Quick calc: reroute +415 + duty delta estimate +980 = 1,395. Soft-fail handling ~150/unit. If vendor credits $225 for 2 units that's $450 credit. Net reroute scenario ~1,095. Waiting scenario: no immediate fees but opportunity cost of ~2,500. Recommend reroute if vendor will sign fee-waive amendment instead of us paying +415.

maya (procurement): Can vendor commit in writing to waive the +415 if we accept a contractual uplift of +6 units on the next committed wave? We need written confirmation and the uplift serials so we can pre-stage. Also need the vendor to push the PDF labels for the 2 soft-fail units to RMA-43124 now.

alpha-logistics (supply-broker): We can agree to waive the +$415 reroute fee conditional on Redwood signing a one-off amendment for +6 uplift in the next wave. We'll provide the +6 serials by EOD and upload PDF return_labels_RMA-43124.pdf to the RMA ticket. We'll also update the commercial invoice to reflect HS 8542.31 and pre-pay an estimated duty hold to speed customs (we'll invoice later). Sending amendment draft to procurement channel. :white_check_mark:

sophia (ops): Posting manifest snippet for depot reconciliation (vendor please confirm full list):

```
AWB: 7777-2400
arrival partial (36):
- A800-SN-300121
- A800-SN-300122  (soft-fail QC)
- H200-SN-100981
- ... (total 36)
```

Reminder: depot auto-close policy: if PDF labels not attached to RMA within 2 hours of arrival, quarantine = true. rma-bot will mark quarantine flag.

rma-bot: reminder: attach PDF 4x6 labels to RMA-43124. If not attached before arrival_time (2026-03-25T04:00:00Z) then depot_quarantine=true.

dan (fleet): Sounds like we have vendor agreement. Procurement please get countersigned amendment and uplift serials. Once labels live and legal signs, authorize FRA reroute.

maya (procurement): On it. I'll post the amendment link and confirm when countersigned. If all signed we route via FRA and intake to staging.

alpha-logistics (supply-broker): Uploaded: return_labels_RMA-43124.pdf and uplift_serials_plus6.csv to the RMA ticket. Amendment draft sent to @maya for signature and to @tom for invoicing details. Will push final commercial invoice with HS note.

maya (procurement): Received. Looping in legal for quick review. Thanks everyone.
